Sentence (English): For several months, I have struggled using my Bosch Series 100 Model SHE41CM6N dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Using my Bosch 100 Series SHE41CM6N/29 Dishwasher ] || ---------------- || For several months, I have struggled using my Bosch Series 100 Model SHE41CM6N dishwasher. Though it appears to be well made, the configuration of the racks is daunting. I struggle to find slots on the racks to accommodate my Corning ceramic dishware and an assortment of plastic tumblers. If you are able, you would be wise to take a sample of your dishes and tumblers to a showroom model and see if you can devise a strategy for loading the racks. Here are the problems that I experienced in placing my dishware on any rack:. • Wire rack tines are grouped into different areas by the spacing between the tines. For example, some tine groups have narrow spacing and will accommodate only flat dinner plates but not cereal bowls. I quickly run out of spaces that fit a particular shape. I would have had almost no issues if most small spaces had been larger so most any size of dishware would fit. • A significant area of the upper rack is designed for large objects, such as pots. By design, that area is unable to securely hold small objects. If you generally have nothing large, this space is mostly unusable. Drinkware is cleaned in the upper rack, but there can be a major issue. I use plastic tumblers because they are lightweight, decorative, and thankfully break resistant. But these tumblers can bounce around while being washed and have been found sitting upright and filled to the brim with water. I needed to find a way to secure them; I now place an inverted wire basket on top of the tumblers and fasten this inverted “nest” to the dishwasher rack to immobilize them. Also, since the tumblers are plastic, they do not dry well, but this is common among some other dishwashers. • The bottom of the lower rack has large openings. It is impractical and maybe even unsafe to attempt to place small objects on them since they could shift under water pressure and fall through the rack onto the rotating sprinkler. • The plastic basket that holds utensils has 2 hinged covers, which have an array of holes for inserting the utensils and keeping them upright and separate. In my situation, almost all of my handles are too wide: my utensils will not insert through these holes; I must leave all the covers “open” and just clump the utensils in the compartments. Of course, small objects can be placed in any compartment, but an open cover would allow them to escape and bounce around the dishwasher. Unfortunately, each compartment does not have its own cover, so this problem is more extensive. (Note: you can solve this problem by buying a small stainless steel basket with a cover from online sources.). What happens when you dry metal utensils in a plastic basket? Answer: the plastic does not dry completely and the utensils it holds may be a little wet. A stainless steel basket for utensils could resolve the issue, but I have not found an equivalent one that fits this dishwasher model and that suits my budget. I continue to use my dishware (on extra dry and without a rinse aid). My ceramic plateware is dry and really shines. This dishwasher is pleasantly quieter than my old one. I hope this information helps you find a dishwasher that suits most all your needs.

Sentence (English): I recently remodeled my home and replaced my dishwasher.
Comments (English): I recently remodeled my home and replaced my dishwasher. I had been using an LG dishwasher I purchased in 2019, but it was quite old, and with the kitchen renovation, I wanted to replace it with a model that satisfied me in both design and interior layout. That's why I chose the LG Dios Objet Collection 14-seat built-in dishwasher. I installed it 15 feet apart to match the sink cabinets, and I'm absolutely delighted with the result. The built-in design makes the kitchen look much cleaner, and the Objet Collection's signature design makes it feel more like furniture than appliances. I think interior designers will especially appreciate this. The interior layout has also been significantly improved compared to the previous model. Previously, I had difficulty placing frying pans and large pots, but this model has a dedicated frying pan rack, making it easy to store large, wide utensils. I also appreciate the separate knife rack, which keeps sharp knives safe. It may seem like a small change, but it's actually much more convenient. The most noticeable change is the detergent dispenser. The previous model was a bit of a hassle to use solid detergents, but this model has a dedicated space for them, making it incredibly convenient. I can use the right detergent for the right situation without worrying about the type, which has significantly improved my user experience. I'm also very satisfied with the cleaning performance. Even greasy dishes and frying pans are cleaned thoroughly in one go, and there are relatively few water stains after drying. It's also quieter than I expected, so I don't have to worry about running it in the evening or at night. It's also great for 14 people, so I can easily handle a large load of dishes in one go. Overall, the design, storage layout, and ease of use have all been upgraded, making this model a great choice. If you're considering a built-in dishwasher for your home decor, you'll be completely satisfied with this model. It's also a great upgrade for those who are currently using an LG dishwasher.

I had been using an LG dishwasher I purchased in 2019, but it was quite old, and with the kitchen renovation, I wanted to replace it with a model that satisfied me in both design and interior layout. That's why I chose the LG Dios Objet Collection 14-seat built-in dishwasher. I installed it 15 feet apart to match the sink cabinets, and I'm absolutely delighted with the result. The built-in design makes the kitchen look much cleaner, and the Objet Collection's signature design makes it feel more like furniture than appliances. I think interior designers will especially appreciate this. The interior layout has also been significantly improved compared to the previous model. Previously, I had difficulty placing frying pans and large pots, but this model has a dedicated frying pan rack, making it easy to store large, wide utensils. I also appreciate the separate knife rack, which keeps sharp knives safe. It may seem like a small change, but it's actually much more convenient. The most noticeable change is the detergent dispenser. The previous model was a bit of a hassle to use solid detergents, but this model has a dedicated space for them, making it incredibly convenient. I can use the right detergent for the right situation without worrying about the type, which has significantly improved my user experience. I'm also very satisfied with the cleaning performance. Even greasy dishes and frying pans are cleaned thoroughly in one go, and there are relatively few water stains after drying. It's also quieter than I expected, so I don't have to worry about running it in the evening or at night. It's also great for 14 people, so I can easily handle a large load of dishes in one go. Overall, the design, storage layout, and ease of use have all been upgraded, making this model a great choice. If you're considering a built-in dishwasher for your home decor, you'll be completely satisfied with this model. It's also a great upgrade for those who are currently using an LG dishwasher.
Comments (Original): 이번에 집 인테리어를 하면서 식기세척기도 함께 교체했어요. 기존에 2019년에 구매한 LG 식기세척기를 쓰고 있었는데, 연식도 꽤 되었고 주방 인테리어를 새로 하다 보니 디자인과 내부 구성까지 만족스러운 모델로 바꾸고 싶더라고요. 그렇게 선택한 제품이 LG 디오스 오브제컬렉션 빌트인 식기세척기 14인용입니다.싱크대 가구와 라인을 맞추기 위해 15발 띄움으로 설치했는데, 결과적으로 정말 만족스러워요. 빌트인이다 보니 주방이 훨씬 깔끔해 보이고, 오브제컬렉션 특유의 디자인 덕분에 가전 느낌보다는 가구처럼 자연스럽게 어우러집니다. 인테리어 하시는 분들이라면 이 부분은 특히 마음에 드실 것 같아요.기존 모델 대비 내부 구성도 확실히 좋아졌어요. 예전에는 후라이팬이나 큰 냄비 넣을 때 애매했는데, 이 제품은 후라이팬 전용 랙이 있어서 크고 넓은 조리도구들도 안정적으로 넣을 수 있어요. 또 칼 전용 랙이 따로 있어서 날카로운 칼들을 안전하게 보관할 수 있는 점도 마음에 들었습니다. 사소한 차이 같지만 실제로 써보면 훨씬 편해요.가장 체감이 컸던 변화는 세제 투입 방식이에요. 예전 모델은 고체 타입 세제를 쓸 때마다 조금 번거로웠는데, 이번 모델은 고체 타입 세제를 넣을 수 있는 전용 공간이 생겨서 정말 편해졌어요. 세제 종류 고민 없이 상황에 맞게 사용할 수 있어서 실사용 만족도가 확 올라갔습니다.세척력도 만족스러워요. 기름기 많은 그릇이나 프라이팬도 한 번에 깔끔하게 세척되고, 건조 후 물자국도 적은 편이에요. 소음도 생각보다 조용해서 저녁 시간대나 밤에 돌려도 부담이 없습니다. 14인용이라 식기 양이 많은 날에도 여유 있게 한 번에 돌릴 수 있는 점도 좋고요.전체적으로 디자인, 수납 구성, 사용 편의성까지 모두 업그레이드된 느낌이라 바꾸길 정말 잘했다는 생각이 들어요. 인테리어 하면서 빌트인 식기세척기 고민 중이시라면 이 모델 충분히 만족하실 것 같습니다. 기존 LG 식기세척기 사용하시던 분들이 업그레이드용으로 선택하기에도 잘 맞는 제품이에요.

Sentence (English): Against my better judgment, I installed a GE dishwasher to match my other appliances.
Comments (English): [ Leaking within the first week ] || ---------------- || Against my better judgment, I installed a GE dishwasher to match my other appliances. Within one week, water was leaking from the right side of the door.That's when the real experience began.I called GE to schedule service, only to learn the earliest available appointment was two weeks out. In the meantime, I did my own troubleshooting and found the issue to be a deformed door gasket on the right side—a simple, obvious failure.Naturally, I asked if GE could just send the replacement part so I could resolve it myself. No luck. The gasket is backordered until February.So I asked the obvious question: What exactly is the technician going to do? The answer appears to be: show up, confirm what I already know, and tell me to wait even longer for the same unavailable part.I requested escalation, since it's unreasonable to be without a dishwasher on a brand-new unit due to GE's supply issues. I then asked if they would simply replace the dishwasher. I was told that only a technician can determine that a part is unrepairable, which—again—requires waiting weeks for an appointment, followed by additional weeks for a backordered part.At this point, I'm waiting to see whether GE can maybe expedite the part before they decide what to do next.The most astounding part of this entire process is GE's complete unwillingness to stand behind their product or prioritize customer satisfaction. A brand-new appliance fails immediately, parts aren't available, and the customer is left in limbo.GE: Go Elsewhere Appliances.

A brand-new appliance fails immediately, parts aren’t available, and the customer is left in limbo.GE: Go Elsewhere Appliances.

Sentence (English): We recently had this Maytag dishwasher installed, to replace an old Whirlpool dishwasher that was around 20 years old.
Comments (English): [ Low Frills, but Great Cleaning ] || ---------------- || We recently had this Maytag dishwasher installed, to replace an old Whirlpool dishwasher that was around 20 years old.One thing that I was a little disappointed with in the beginning is the instructions - there is very little there. Most of the information is on a quick-start guide that is the front and back of one page. The rest of the booklet that comes with the dishwasher is mostly warranty info and safety warnings.This model doesn't have a lot of cycle options - there are Auto, Normal, and Quick wash cycles, with a PowerBlast option. There are are also High Temp and Sani Rinse modes, and Heated Dry can be set to Short, Long, or None. Auto is supposed to set the wash options for you, but it is not clear what kind of sensors it is using. It has always set the cycle to Normal with Short Heated Dry when I have pressed it. I have so far run all washes on Normal with no Heated Dry. With the exception of two bowls on two different washes that came out still dirty, everything has come out of the new dishwasher clean, and in most cases it is already dry despite not using the heated dry option. I am very pleased with the cleaning performance and drying on the Maytag. With our old dishwasher we rinsed everything before putting it in and we no longer have to do that. We used to wash anything really dirty or large by hand, and even still some things would come out dirty from the old dishwasher. Plastic items also frequently came out wet from the old dishwasher, but I only have to towel dry items occasionally with the Maytag, and that is without using the heated dry option.The cycles do take much longer than our old dishwasher - I think the Normal cycle usually takes around 2.5 hours. The Maytag is a little quieter than our old dishwasher, but it isn't silent - if you are in the same room you will hear it, and if you are in a nearby room without a door between you may be able to hear it there as well.We got the model in black, and I think it looks nice. With the exception of the controls, a small screen, and the recessed handle, the front is smooth - even the Maytag logo is hidden on the top of the door until you open it. On the inside, the tub is stainless steel and there are two racks. The racks are coated metal and plastic. The utensil basket is solid plastic. You won't find any adjustable items in this one - no stemware holders or tines that fold down. The utensil basket lifts out and goes back in easily. One thing that I like is that it is much easier to put rinse aid into this dishwasher than my old one - someone finally made a design that is easier to pour into.Overall, I think this dishwasher does a great job, and although it doesn't have a lot of features, I think it does the most important things at a reasonable price compared to the other options on the market.

I am very pleased with the cleaning performance and drying on the Maytag.  With our old dishwasher we rinsed everything before putting it in and we no longer have to do that.  We used to wash anything really dirty or large by hand, and even still some things would come out dirty from the old dishwasher.  Plastic items also frequently came out wet from the old dishwasher, but I only have to towel dry items occasionally with the Maytag, and that is without using the heated dry option.The cycles do take much longer than our old dishwasher - I think the Normal cycle usually takes around 2.5 hours.  The Maytag is a little quieter than our old dishwasher, but it isn't silent - if you are in the same room you will hear it, and if you are in a nearby room without a door between you may be able to hear it there as well.We got the model in black, and I think it looks nice.  With the exception of the controls, a small screen, and the recessed handle, the front is smooth - even the Maytag logo is hidden on the top of the door until you open it.  On the inside, the tub is stainless steel and there are two racks.  The racks are coated metal and plastic.  The utensil basket is solid plastic.  You won't find any adjustable items in this one - no stemware holders or tines that fold down.  The utensil basket lifts out and goes back in easily.  One thing that I like is that it is much easier to put rinse aid into this dishwasher than my old one - someone finally made a design that is easier to pour into.Overall, I think this dishwasher does a great job, and although it doesn't have a lot of features, I think it does the most important things at a reasonable price compared to the other options on the market.

Sentence (English): My old dishwasher had been in use for over five years.
Comments (English): My old dishwasher had been in use for over five years. When I moved, I removed it to relocate it, but an unexpected problem arose. When I tried to replace it, the cabinets had absorbed moisture and wouldn't recover. The cost of replacing the cabinets and relocating the dishwasher easily exceeded 500,000 won. After much deliberation, I decided not to reinstall the old dishwasher in my new home, leaving it as a gift to the buyer. I decided that if I were going to buy a new one anyway, I'd go with the latest model with upgraded features. <Pros>: *The nature beige color enhances the kitchen atmosphere. The nature beige color, a signature color of the Objet Collection, is softer than white and warmer than gray, creating a more stable atmosphere in the kitchen. I especially liked how the built-in appliances blend in seamlessly with the kitchen furniture, without standing out. *The hot air drying is noticeably improved compared to the previous model. I was also very satisfied with my previous LG dishwasher, but... This model definitely feels like it's improved drying performance. Because it uses hot air to dry the interior, regular plates, cups, and spoons dry almost completely dry. Except for dishes with grooves that collect water, the overall drying performance is excellent. The hassle of having to wipe them down after washing has been significantly reduced. *The use of calcium chloride reduces concerns about water stains. This model uses calcium chloride to regulate the water's properties. After washing, there are virtually no water stains or white spots on the dishes. When I take out glasses or plates, they're so clean I wonder if they're not completely dry. This is a definite advantage over the previous model. *The dedicated tablet compartment makes it even more convenient. Previously, it was sometimes difficult to figure out where to put the tablets, but this model has a dedicated compartment for them, making it much more convenient. Just open the door, put the detergent in the bottom, and it automatically applies it according to the washing cycle, so I feel like I don't have to worry about anything else. *The combination of automatic door opening and TrueSteam. After the dishwasher is finished, the door automatically opens, naturally discharging any internal moisture. Thanks to the TrueSteam function, even greasy dishes are cleaned and odor-free, and the overall hygienic feel is satisfying. * Generous capacity and practical storage. With a large capacity for 14 people, I can clean up dishes, pots, and pans after a meal all at once. The basket adjustment is smooth and practical, making it easy to load and remove large dishes and cooking utensils. * Strengths of the dishwasher compared to the Samtaeng. Many people may be considering the Samtaeng dishwasher, but the strengths I felt after using it are its cleaning power and reliable drying performance. The LG dishwasher, thanks to its TrueSteam and hot air dryer, is reliable in removing grease and odors, and its drying finish is quite clean. The intuitive internal structure and cleaning cycles also make it easy for first-time users to quickly get used to it, which I found to be a plus. <Disappointing Points> * Due to the built-in nature of the product, moving and demolition costs are burdensome. What was the biggest takeaway from this move? One thing about built-in dishwashers is that they can be quite expensive to relocate. Considering the cost of the appliance and the cost of relocation, I thought purchasing a new model might be a more reasonable option for older models. *It's not perfect drying. While I'm generally very satisfied with the hot air drying performance, dishes with deep grooves or structures that collect water may retain a small amount of moisture. However, this doesn't significantly affect actual use. Despite the variable of moving, it was ultimately a satisfactory choice. The design, cleaning power, and drying performance are all reliable. Compared to the previous model, the hot air drying and water stain management have been significantly improved. If you were satisfied with your previous LG dishwasher, this upgrade is definitely worth considering for a more luxurious life. With a design that blends seamlessly into your kitchen and reduces the burden of dishwashing, this dishwasher will become more satisfying the more you use it.

Sentence (English): When I tried to replace it, the cabinets had absorbed moisture and wouldn't recover.
Comments (English): My old dishwasher had been in use for over five years. When I moved, I removed it to relocate it, but an unexpected problem arose. When I tried to replace it, the cabinets had absorbed moisture and wouldn't recover. The cost of replacing the cabinets and relocating the dishwasher easily exceeded 500,000 won. After much deliberation, I decided not to reinstall the old dishwasher in my new home, leaving it as a gift to the buyer. I decided that if I were going to buy a new one anyway, I'd go with the latest model with upgraded features. <Pros>: *The nature beige color enhances the kitchen atmosphere. The nature beige color, a signature color of the Objet Collection, is softer than white and warmer than gray, creating a more stable atmosphere in the kitchen. I especially liked how the built-in appliances blend in seamlessly with the kitchen furniture, without standing out. *The hot air drying is noticeably improved compared to the previous model. I was also very satisfied with my previous LG dishwasher, but... This model definitely feels like it's improved drying performance. Because it uses hot air to dry the interior, regular plates, cups, and spoons dry almost completely dry. Except for dishes with grooves that collect water, the overall drying performance is excellent. The hassle of having to wipe them down after washing has been significantly reduced. *The use of calcium chloride reduces concerns about water stains. This model uses calcium chloride to regulate the water's properties. After washing, there are virtually no water stains or white spots on the dishes. When I take out glasses or plates, they're so clean I wonder if they're not completely dry. This is a definite advantage over the previous model. *The dedicated tablet compartment makes it even more convenient. Previously, it was sometimes difficult to figure out where to put the tablets, but this model has a dedicated compartment for them, making it much more convenient. Just open the door, put the detergent in the bottom, and it automatically applies it according to the washing cycle, so I feel like I don't have to worry about anything else. *The combination of automatic door opening and TrueSteam. After the dishwasher is finished, the door automatically opens, naturally discharging any internal moisture. Thanks to the TrueSteam function, even greasy dishes are cleaned and odor-free, and the overall hygienic feel is satisfying. * Generous capacity and practical storage. With a large capacity for 14 people, I can clean up dishes, pots, and pans after a meal all at once. The basket adjustment is smooth and practical, making it easy to load and remove large dishes and cooking utensils. * Strengths of the dishwasher compared to the Samtaeng. Many people may be considering the Samtaeng dishwasher, but the strengths I felt after using it are its cleaning power and reliable drying performance. The LG dishwasher, thanks to its TrueSteam and hot air dryer, is reliable in removing grease and odors, and its drying finish is quite clean. The intuitive internal structure and cleaning cycles also make it easy for first-time users to quickly get used to it, which I found to be a plus. <Disappointing Points> * Due to the built-in nature of the product, moving and demolition costs are burdensome. What was the biggest takeaway from this move? One thing about built-in dishwashers is that they can be quite expensive to relocate. Considering the cost of the appliance and the cost of relocation, I thought purchasing a new model might be a more reasonable option for older models. *It's not perfect drying. While I'm generally very satisfied with the hot air drying performance, dishes with deep grooves or structures that collect water may retain a small amount of moisture. However, this doesn't significantly affect actual use. Despite the variable of moving, it was ultimately a satisfactory choice. The design, cleaning power, and drying performance are all reliable. Compared to the previous model, the hot air drying and water stain management have been significantly improved. If you were satisfied with your previous LG dishwasher, this upgrade is definitely worth considering for a more luxurious life. With a design that blends seamlessly into your kitchen and reduces the burden of dishwashing, this dishwasher will become more satisfying the more you use it.

After much deliberation, I decided not to reinstall the old dishwasher in my new home, leaving it as a gift to the buyer. I decided that if I were going to buy a new one anyway, I'd go with the latest model with upgraded features. <Pros>: *The nature beige color enhances the kitchen atmosphere. The nature beige color, a signature color of the Objet Collection, is softer than white and warmer than gray, creating a more stable atmosphere in the kitchen. I especially liked how the built-in appliances blend in seamlessly with the kitchen furniture, without standing out. *The hot air drying is noticeably improved compared to the previous model. I was also very satisfied with my previous LG dishwasher, but... This model definitely feels like it's improved drying performance. Because it uses hot air to dry the interior, regular plates, cups, and spoons dry almost completely dry. Except for dishes with grooves that collect water, the overall drying performance is excellent. The hassle of having to wipe them down after washing has been significantly reduced. *The use of calcium chloride reduces concerns about water stains. This model uses calcium chloride to regulate the water's properties. After washing, there are virtually no water stains or white spots on the dishes. When I take out glasses or plates, they're so clean I wonder if they're not completely dry. This is a definite advantage over the previous model. *The dedicated tablet compartment makes it even more convenient. Previously, it was sometimes difficult to figure out where to put the tablets, but this model has a dedicated compartment for them, making it much more convenient. Just open the door, put the detergent in the bottom, and it automatically applies it according to the washing cycle, so I feel like I don't have to worry about anything else. *The combination of automatic door opening and TrueSteam. After the dishwasher is finished, the door automatically opens, naturally discharging any internal moisture. Thanks to the TrueSteam function, even greasy dishes are cleaned and odor-free, and the overall hygienic feel is satisfying. * Generous capacity and practical storage. With a large capacity for 14 people, I can clean up dishes, pots, and pans after a meal all at once. The basket adjustment is smooth and practical, making it easy to load and remove large dishes and cooking utensils. * Strengths of the dishwasher compared to the Samtaeng. Many people may be considering the Samtaeng dishwasher, but the strengths I felt after using it are its cleaning power and reliable drying performance. The LG dishwasher, thanks to its TrueSteam and hot air dryer, is reliable in removing grease and odors, and its drying finish is quite clean. The intuitive internal structure and cleaning cycles also make it easy for first-time users to quickly get used to it, which I found to be a plus. <Disappointing Points> * Due to the built-in nature of the product, moving and demolition costs are burdensome. What was the biggest takeaway from this move? One thing about built-in dishwashers is that they can be quite expensive to relocate. Considering the cost of the appliance and the cost of relocation, I thought purchasing a new model might be a more reasonable option for older models. *It's not perfect drying. While I'm generally very satisfied with the hot air drying performance, dishes with deep grooves or structures that collect water may retain a small amount of moisture. However, this doesn't significantly affect actual use. Despite the variable of moving, it was ultimately a satisfactory choice. The design, cleaning power, and drying performance are all reliable. Compared to the previous model, the hot air drying and water stain management have been significantly improved. If you were satisfied with your previous LG dishwasher, this upgrade is definitely worth considering for a more luxurious life. With a design that blends seamlessly into your kitchen and reduces the burden of dishwashing, this dishwasher will become more satisfying the more you use it.

Comments (English): My old dishwasher had been in use for over five years. When I moved, I removed it to relocate it, but an unexpected problem arose. After much deliberation, I decided not to reinstall the old dishwasher in my new home, leaving it as a gift to the buyer. I decided that if I were going to buy a new one anyway, I'd go with the latest model with upgraded features. <Pros>: *The nature beige color enhances the kitchen atmosphere. The nature beige color, a signature color of the Objet Collection, is softer than white and warmer than gray, creating a more stable atmosphere in the kitchen. I especially liked how the built-in appliances blend in seamlessly with the kitchen furniture, without standing out. *The hot air drying is noticeably improved compared to the previous model. I was also very satisfied with my previous LG dishwasher, but... This model definitely feels like it's improved drying performance. Because it uses hot air to dry the interior, regular plates, cups, and spoons dry almost completely dry. Except for dishes with grooves that collect water, the overall drying performance is excellent. The hassle of having to wipe them down after washing has been significantly reduced. *The use of calcium chloride reduces concerns about water stains. This model uses calcium chloride to regulate the water's properties. After washing, there are virtually no water stains or white spots on the dishes. When I take out glasses or plates, they're so clean I wonder if they're not completely dry. This is a definite advantage over the previous model. *The dedicated tablet compartment makes it even more convenient. Previously, it was sometimes difficult to figure out where to put the tablets, but this model has a dedicated compartment for them, making it much more convenient. Just open the door, put the detergent in the bottom, and it automatically applies it according to the washing cycle, so I feel like I don't have to worry about anything else. *The combination of automatic door opening and TrueSteam. After the dishwasher is finished, the door automatically opens, naturally discharging any internal moisture. Thanks to the TrueSteam function, even greasy dishes are cleaned and odor-free, and the overall hygienic feel is satisfying. * Generous capacity and practical storage. With a large capacity for 14 people, I can clean up dishes, pots, and pans after a meal all at once. The basket adjustment is smooth and practical, making it easy to load and remove large dishes and cooking utensils. * Strengths of the dishwasher compared to the Samtaeng. Many people may be considering the Samtaeng dishwasher, but the strengths I felt after using it are its cleaning power and reliable drying performance. The LG dishwasher, thanks to its TrueSteam and hot air dryer, is reliable in removing grease and odors, and its drying finish is quite clean. The intuitive internal structure and cleaning cycles also make it easy for first-time users to quickly get used to it, which I found to be a plus. <Disappointing Points> * Due to the built-in nature of the product, moving and demolition costs are burdensome. What was the biggest takeaway from this move? One thing about built-in dishwashers is that they can be quite expensive to relocate. Considering the cost of the appliance and the cost of relocation, I thought purchasing a new model might be a more reasonable option for older models. *It's not perfect drying. While I'm generally very satisfied with the hot air drying performance, dishes with deep grooves or structures that collect water may retain a small amount of moisture. However, this doesn't significantly affect actual use. Despite the variable of moving, it was ultimately a satisfactory choice. The design, cleaning power, and drying performance are all reliable. Compared to the previous model, the hot air drying and water stain management have been significantly improved. If you were satisfied with your previous LG dishwasher, this upgrade is definitely worth considering for a more luxurious life. With a design that blends seamlessly into your kitchen and reduces the burden of dishwashing, this dishwasher will become more satisfying the more you use it.

When I tried to replace it, the cabinets had absorbed moisture and wouldn't recover. The cost of replacing the cabinets and relocating the dishwasher easily exceeded 500,000 won. After much deliberation, I decided not to reinstall the old dishwasher in my new home, leaving it as a gift to the buyer. I decided that if I were going to buy a new one anyway, I'd go with the latest model with upgraded features. <Pros>: *The nature beige color enhances the kitchen atmosphere. The nature beige color, a signature color of the Objet Collection, is softer than white and warmer than gray, creating a more stable atmosphere in the kitchen. I especially liked how the built-in appliances blend in seamlessly with the kitchen furniture, without standing out. *The hot air drying is noticeably improved compared to the previous model. I was also very satisfied with my previous LG dishwasher, but... This model definitely feels like it's improved drying performance. Because it uses hot air to dry the interior, regular plates, cups, and spoons dry almost completely dry. Except for dishes with grooves that collect water, the overall drying performance is excellent. The hassle of having to wipe them down after washing has been significantly reduced. *The use of calcium chloride reduces concerns about water stains. This model uses calcium chloride to regulate the water's properties. After washing, there are virtually no water stains or white spots on the dishes. When I take out glasses or plates, they're so clean I wonder if they're not completely dry. This is a definite advantage over the previous model. *The dedicated tablet compartment makes it even more convenient. Previously, it was sometimes difficult to figure out where to put the tablets, but this model has a dedicated compartment for them, making it much more convenient. Just open the door, put the detergent in the bottom, and it automatically applies it according to the washing cycle, so I feel like I don't have to worry about anything else. *The combination of automatic door opening and TrueSteam. After the dishwasher is finished, the door automatically opens, naturally discharging any internal moisture. Thanks to the TrueSteam function, even greasy dishes are cleaned and odor-free, and the overall hygienic feel is satisfying. * Generous capacity and practical storage. With a large capacity for 14 people, I can clean up dishes, pots, and pans after a meal all at once. The basket adjustment is smooth and practical, making it easy to load and remove large dishes and cooking utensils. * Strengths of the dishwasher compared to the Samtaeng. Many people may be considering the Samtaeng dishwasher, but the strengths I felt after using it are its cleaning power and reliable drying performance. The LG dishwasher, thanks to its TrueSteam and hot air dryer, is reliable in removing grease and odors, and its drying finish is quite clean. The intuitive internal structure and cleaning cycles also make it easy for first-time users to quickly get used to it, which I found to be a plus. <Disappointing Points> * Due to the built-in nature of the product, moving and demolition costs are burdensome. What was the biggest takeaway from this move? One thing about built-in dishwashers is that they can be quite expensive to relocate. Considering the cost of the appliance and the cost of relocation, I thought purchasing a new model might be a more reasonable option for older models. *It's not perfect drying. While I'm generally very satisfied with the hot air drying performance, dishes with deep grooves or structures that collect water may retain a small amount of moisture. However, this doesn't significantly affect actual use. Despite the variable of moving, it was ultimately a satisfactory choice. The design, cleaning power, and drying performance are all reliable. Compared to the previous model, the hot air drying and water stain management have been significantly improved. If you were satisfied with your previous LG dishwasher, this upgrade is definitely worth considering for a more luxurious life. With a design that blends seamlessly into your kitchen and reduces the burden of dishwashing, this dishwasher will become more satisfying the more you use it.
Comments (Original): 기존에 사용하던 식기세척기는 5년 이상 사용한 제품이었어요.이사를 하면서 식기세척기를 이전 설치하려고 빼두었는데, 예상치 못한 문제가 생겼습니다.식세기를 뺀 자리에 다시 장을 넣으려 하니, 장이 습기를 먹어 복구가 되지 않더라고요.결국 장을 새로 짜는 비용과 식기세척기 이전 설치 비용을 더하니 50만 원은 가볍게 넘어가는 상황이었습니다.고민 끝에 기존 식기세척기는 새 집에 다시 설치하지 않고집을 구매하신 분께 선물로 두고 나오게 되었어요.어차피 다시 구매해야 한다면 기능이 업그레이드된 최신 모델로 가자는 마음으로 선택했습니다.<좋은점>*주방 분위기를 살려주는 네이처베이지 컬러오브제컬렉션 특유의 네이처베이지 색상은화이트보다 부드럽고, 그레이보다 따뜻한 느낌이라주방 전체 분위기를 한층 안정감 있게 만들어줘요.빌트인 제품이라 가전이 튀지 않고주방 가구처럼 자연스럽게 어우러지는 점이 특히 마음에 들었습니다.*이전 모델 대비 확실히 좋아진 열풍 건조기존에 사용하던 LG 식기세척기도 만족도가 높았지만,이번 모델은 건조 성능이 확실히 업그레이드된 느낌이에요.열풍으로 내부를 말려주기 때문에일반 접시나 컵, 수저는 거의 물기 없이 마르고홈이 있어 물이 고이는 그릇을 제외하면 전반적으로 건조 상태가 매우 좋습니다.세척 후 다시 행주로 닦아야 하는 번거로움이 크게 줄었어요.*염화칼슘 사용으로 물때 걱정이 줄어든 점이 모델은 염화칼슘을 사용해 물의 성질을 조절해 주는 기능이 있어세척 후 식기에 남는 물때나 하얀 얼룩이 거의 보이지 않아요.유리컵이나 접시를 꺼낼 때“덜 마른 건가?” 싶을 정도로 깨끗한 상태라이 부분은 이전 모델 대비 확실히 체감되는 장점이었습니다.*타블릿 세제를 넣는 전용 칸이 생겨 더 편해진 사용성이전에는 타블릿 세제를 어디에 넣어야 할지 애매한 경우가 있었는데,이번 모델은 타블릿 세제를 따로 넣을 수 있는 전용 칸이 생겨 훨씬 편해졌어요.문을 열고 아래쪽에 세제를 넣어두면세척 과정에 맞춰 자동으로 사용되니신경 쓸 일이 줄어든 느낌입니다.*자동 문 열림과 트루스팀의 조합세척이 끝난 후 문이 자동으로 열리면서내부 습기를 자연스럽게 배출해 줍니다.트루스팀 기능 덕분에 기름기 많은 식기도 냄새 없이 깔끔하게 마무리되고,전체적으로 위생적인 느낌이 들어 만족스럽습니다.*넉넉한 용량과 실용적인 수납 구조14인용 대용량이라식사 후 나온 식기와 냄비, 프라이팬까지 한 번에 정리할 수 있어요.바스켓 조절도 부드럽고 실용적이라큰 그릇이나 조리도구를 넣고 빼는 것도 수월했습니다.*삼땡과 비교했을 때 느껴지는 식기세척기의 강점삼땡 식기세척기와 고민하시는 분들도 많을 텐데,직접 사용해보며 느낀 식기세척기의 강점은세척력과 건조의 안정감이에요.LG는 트루스팀과 열풍 건조 조합 덕분에기름기 제거와 냄새 관리가 확실하고,건조 후 마무리 상태가 깔끔한 편입니다.또한 내부 구조나 세척 코스가 직관적이라처음 사용하는 사람도 금방 익숙해질 수 있다는 점도 장점으로 느껴졌어요.<아쉬운 점>*빌트인 제품 특성상 이전·철거 비용 부담이번 이사를 통해 가장 크게 느낀 점은빌트인 식기세척기는 이전 설치 시 비용 부담이 크다는 점이에요.장 비용과 이전 설치 비용을 함께 고려하면오래 사용한 제품의 경우 새 제품 구매가 더 합리적인 선택일 수도 있겠다는 생각이 들었습니다.*완벽한 건조는 아님열풍 건조 성능이 전반적으로 매우 만족스럽긴 하지만,홈이 깊거나 구조상 물이 고이는 그릇은소량의 물기가 남을 수 있습니다.다만 실사용에는 크게 불편하지 않은 수준이에요.ㅡㅡㅡㅡㅡㅡㅡㅡㅡㅡㅡㅡㅡㅡㅡㅡㅡㅡㅡㅡㅡㅡ이사라는 변수가 있었지만, 결과적으로는 만족스러운 선택이었습니다.디자인, 세척력, 건조 성능 모두 안정적이고특히 이전 모델 대비 열풍 건조와 물때 관리 부분이 확실히 좋아졌어요.기존에 LG 식기세척기를 사용해 만족했던 분들이라면업그레이드버전으로 윤택한 삶을 위해 충분히 고려해볼 만한 제품이라고 생각합니다.주방에 자연스럽게 녹아드는 디자인에설거지 부담까지 줄여주니사용할수록 만족도가 높아지는 식기세척기입니다.

Sentence (English): The LG dishwasher, thanks to its TrueSteam and hot air dryer, is reliable in removing grease and odors, and its drying finish is quite clean.
Comments (English): My old dishwasher had been in use for over five years. When I moved, I removed it to relocate it, but an unexpected problem arose. When I tried to replace it, the cabinets had absorbed moisture and wouldn't recover. The cost of replacing the cabinets and relocating the dishwasher easily exceeded 500,000 won. After much deliberation, I decided not to reinstall the old dishwasher in my new home, leaving it as a gift to the buyer. I decided that if I were going to buy a new one anyway, I'd go with the latest model with upgraded features. <Pros>: *The nature beige color enhances the kitchen atmosphere. The nature beige color, a signature color of the Objet Collection, is softer than white and warmer than gray, creating a more stable atmosphere in the kitchen. I especially liked how the built-in appliances blend in seamlessly with the kitchen furniture, without standing out. *The hot air drying is noticeably improved compared to the previous model. I was also very satisfied with my previous LG dishwasher, but... This model definitely feels like it's improved drying performance. Because it uses hot air to dry the interior, regular plates, cups, and spoons dry almost completely dry. Except for dishes with grooves that collect water, the overall drying performance is excellent. The hassle of having to wipe them down after washing has been significantly reduced. *The use of calcium chloride reduces concerns about water stains. This model uses calcium chloride to regulate the water's properties. After washing, there are virtually no water stains or white spots on the dishes. When I take out glasses or plates, they're so clean I wonder if they're not completely dry. This is a definite advantage over the previous model. *The dedicated tablet compartment makes it even more convenient. Previously, it was sometimes difficult to figure out where to put the tablets, but this model has a dedicated compartment for them, making it much more convenient. Just open the door, put the detergent in the bottom, and it automatically applies it according to the washing cycle, so I feel like I don't have to worry about anything else. *The combination of automatic door opening and TrueSteam. After the dishwasher is finished, the door automatically opens, naturally discharging any internal moisture. Thanks to the TrueSteam function, even greasy dishes are cleaned and odor-free, and the overall hygienic feel is satisfying. * Generous capacity and practical storage. With a large capacity for 14 people, I can clean up dishes, pots, and pans after a meal all at once. The basket adjustment is smooth and practical, making it easy to load and remove large dishes and cooking utensils. * Strengths of the dishwasher compared to the Samtaeng. Many people may be considering the Samtaeng dishwasher, but the strengths I felt after using it are its cleaning power and reliable drying performance. The LG dishwasher, thanks to its TrueSteam and hot air dryer, is reliable in removing grease and odors, and its drying finish is quite clean. The intuitive internal structure and cleaning cycles also make it easy for first-time users to quickly get used to it, which I found to be a plus. <Disappointing Points> * Due to the built-in nature of the product, moving and demolition costs are burdensome. What was the biggest takeaway from this move? One thing about built-in dishwashers is that they can be quite expensive to relocate. Considering the cost of the appliance and the cost of relocation, I thought purchasing a new model might be a more reasonable option for older models. *It's not perfect drying. While I'm generally very satisfied with the hot air drying performance, dishes with deep grooves or structures that collect water may retain a small amount of moisture. However, this doesn't significantly affect actual use. Despite the variable of moving, it was ultimately a satisfactory choice. The design, cleaning power, and drying performance are all reliable. Compared to the previous model, the hot air drying and water stain management have been significantly improved. If you were satisfied with your previous LG dishwasher, this upgrade is definitely worth considering for a more luxurious life. With a design that blends seamlessly into your kitchen and reduces the burden of dishwashing, this dishwasher will become more satisfying the more you use it.

After much deliberation, I decided not to reinstall the old dishwasher in my new home, leaving it as a gift to the buyer. I decided that if I were going to buy a new one anyway, I'd go with the latest model with upgraded features. <Pros>: *The nature beige color enhances the kitchen atmosphere. The nature beige color, a signature color of the Objet Collection, is softer than white and warmer than gray, creating a more stable atmosphere in the kitchen. I especially liked how the built-in appliances blend in seamlessly with the kitchen furniture, without standing out. *The hot air drying is noticeably improved compared to the previous model. I was also very satisfied with my previous LG dishwasher, but... This model definitely feels like it's improved drying performance. Because it uses hot air to dry the interior, regular plates, cups, and spoons dry almost completely dry. Except for dishes with grooves that collect water, the overall drying performance is excellent. The hassle of having to wipe them down after washing has been significantly reduced. *The use of calcium chloride reduces concerns about water stains. This model uses calcium chloride to regulate the water's properties. After washing, there are virtually no water stains or white spots on the dishes. When I take out glasses or plates, they're so clean I wonder if they're not completely dry. This is a definite advantage over the previous model. *The dedicated tablet compartment makes it even more convenient. Previously, it was sometimes difficult to figure out where to put the tablets, but this model has a dedicated compartment for them, making it much more convenient. Just open the door, put the detergent in the bottom, and it automatically applies it according to the washing cycle, so I feel like I don't have to worry about anything else. *The combination of automatic door opening and TrueSteam. After the dishwasher is finished, the door automatically opens, naturally discharging any internal moisture. Thanks to the TrueSteam function, even greasy dishes are cleaned and odor-free, and the overall hygienic feel is satisfying. * Generous capacity and practical storage. With a large capacity for 14 people, I can clean up dishes, pots, and pans after a meal all at once. The basket adjustment is smooth and practical, making it easy to load and remove large dishes and cooking utensils. * Strengths of the dishwasher compared to the Samtaeng. Many people may be considering the Samtaeng dishwasher, but the strengths I felt after using it are its cleaning power and reliable drying performance. The LG dishwasher, thanks to its TrueSteam and hot air dryer, is reliable in removing grease and odors, and its drying finish is quite clean. The intuitive internal structure and cleaning cycles also make it easy for first-time users to quickly get used to it, which I found to be a plus. <Disappointing Points> * Due to the built-in nature of the product, moving and demolition costs are burdensome. What was the biggest takeaway from this move? One thing about built-in dishwashers is that they can be quite expensive to relocate. Considering the cost of the appliance and the cost of relocation, I thought purchasing a new model might be a more reasonable option for older models. *It's not perfect drying. While I'm generally very satisfied with the hot air drying performance, dishes with deep grooves or structures that collect water may retain a small amount of moisture. However, this doesn't significantly affect actual use. Despite the variable of moving, it was ultimately a satisfactory choice. The design, cleaning power, and drying performance are all reliable. Compared to the previous model, the hot air drying and water stain management have been significantly improved. If you were satisfied with your previous LG dishwasher, this upgrade is definitely worth considering for a more luxurious life. With a design that blends seamlessly into your kitchen and reduces the burden of dishwashing, this dishwasher will become more satisfying the more you use it.

After much deliberation, I decided not to reinstall the old dishwasher in my new home, leaving it as a gift to the buyer. I decided that if I were going to buy a new one anyway, I'd go with the latest model with upgraded features. <Pros>: *The nature beige color enhances the kitchen atmosphere. The nature beige color, a signature color of the Objet Collection, is softer than white and warmer than gray, creating a more stable atmosphere in the kitchen. I especially liked how the built-in appliances blend in seamlessly with the kitchen furniture, without standing out. *The hot air drying is noticeably improved compared to the previous model. I was also very satisfied with my previous LG dishwasher, but... This model definitely feels like it's improved drying performance. Because it uses hot air to dry the interior, regular plates, cups, and spoons dry almost completely dry. Except for dishes with grooves that collect water, the overall drying performance is excellent. The hassle of having to wipe them down after washing has been significantly reduced. *The use of calcium chloride reduces concerns about water stains. This model uses calcium chloride to regulate the water's properties. After washing, there are virtually no water stains or white spots on the dishes. When I take out glasses or plates, they're so clean I wonder if they're not completely dry. This is a definite advantage over the previous model. *The dedicated tablet compartment makes it even more convenient. Previously, it was sometimes difficult to figure out where to put the tablets, but this model has a dedicated compartment for them, making it much more convenient. Just open the door, put the detergent in the bottom, and it automatically applies it according to the washing cycle, so I feel like I don't have to worry about anything else. *The combination of automatic door opening and TrueSteam. After the dishwasher is finished, the door automatically opens, naturally discharging any internal moisture. Thanks to the TrueSteam function, even greasy dishes are cleaned and odor-free, and the overall hygienic feel is satisfying. * Generous capacity and practical storage. With a large capacity for 14 people, I can clean up dishes, pots, and pans after a meal all at once. The basket adjustment is smooth and practical, making it easy to load and remove large dishes and cooking utensils. * Strengths of the dishwasher compared to the Samtaeng. Many people may be considering the Samtaeng dishwasher, but the strengths I felt after using it are its cleaning power and reliable drying performance. The LG dishwasher, thanks to its TrueSteam and hot air dryer, is reliable in removing grease and odors, and its drying finish is quite clean. The intuitive internal structure and cleaning cycles also make it easy for first-time users to quickly get used to it, which I found to be a plus. <Disappointing Points> * Due to the built-in nature of the product, moving and demolition costs are burdensome. What was the biggest takeaway from this move? One thing about built-in dishwashers is that they can be quite expensive to relocate. Considering the cost of the appliance and the cost of relocation, I thought purchasing a new model might be a more reasonable option for older models. *It's not perfect drying. While I'm generally very satisfied with the hot air drying performance, dishes with deep grooves or structures that collect water may retain a small amount of moisture. However, this doesn't significantly affect actual use. Despite the variable of moving, it was ultimately a satisfactory choice. The design, cleaning power, and drying performance are all reliable. Compared to the previous model, the hot air drying and water stain management have been significantly improved. If you were satisfied with your previous LG dishwasher, this upgrade is definitely worth considering for a more luxurious life. With a design that blends seamlessly into your kitchen and reduces the burden of dishwashing, this dishwasher will become more satisfying the more you use it.

Sentence (English): I'm appalled that our old 18-year-old Bosch dishwasher performed significantly better than this one in almost every aspect.
Comments (English): [ An 18-year-old Bosch dishwasher was clearly worn out. ] || ---------------- || I'm appalled that our old 18-year-old Bosch dishwasher performed significantly better than this one in almost every aspect. You can't tell anything about the Zeolite drying technology – water is still pooling on all the dishes, especially those with recesses. This happens even if you open the door immediately after the cycle ends. During the "drying" cycle, this otherwise very quiet appliance is quite loud, which, in my opinion, warrants a higher decibel rating. Plastic containers and stainless steel pots are left with a greasy film of water droplets. Despite trying different settings, the problem persists. Water spots form if you don't dry the items immediately. If you miss the end of the cycle, we have to wipe down the plastic items and stainless steel pots because, besides being unhygienic, it's also unsightly. Our old dishwasher didn't have any of these bells and whistles; it simply evaporated the remaining moisture after opening the door after a two-hour cycle, and voilà! Everything was dry, and there was no greasy film. The cleaning performance is mediocre – even when the machine runs for over three hours. Occasionally, food residue sticks to individual items, even though our dishes are roughly pre-washed before being put in the dishwasher. A good dishwasher should be able to handle what's left, especially since we know it worked with older technology! Overall, I'm appalled that technological development can apparently regress. Our 18-year-old dishwasher was excellent in all areas, such as cycle time and drying performance, and its water consumption wasn't significantly worse. It's very annoying that we now often have to partially wash the dishes by hand again. For the price, I expected something different.
Comments (Original): [ 18 Jahre alter Bosch Geschirrspüler war deutlich b ] || ---------------- || Ich bin entsetzt, dass unser alter 18 Jahre alter Bosch Geschirrspüler in nahezu allen Bereichen deutlich besser abgeschnitten hat, als dieses Gerät. Von der Zeolith drying technology merkt man überhaupt nichts - das Wasser steht überall noch auf dem Geschirr das Vertiefungen hat. Auch wenn man sofort nach Programmende die Tür öffnet. Während der 'Trocknung' ist das doch sonst sehr leise Gerät recht laut, was m.E. eine höhere Dezibelangabe nach sich ziehen müsste. Kunststoff Dosen und Edelstahl Töpfe haben einen schmierigen Wassertropfen Film. Trotz verschiedener Einstellungen bleibt das Problem. Es bilden sich Wasserflecken, wenn man nicht sofort die Teile abtrocknet. Verpasst man das Programmende, wischen wir die Kunststoff Teile und Edelstahl Töpfe aus, da das neben dem hygienischen Aspekt auch unansehnlich ist. Unser 'alter' hatte kein Schnickschnack, dampfte die restliche Feuchtigkeit nach Türöffnung nach 2 Stunden Laufzeit raus und voila... Alles gut getrocknet und kein schmieriger Film. Die Reinigungsleistung ist mittelmäßig - auch wenn die Maschine über drei Stunden läuft. Hin und wieder kleben Reste an einzelnen Teilen, obwohl unser Geschirr, bevor es in die Maschine gestellt wird, grob gut vorgereinigt wird. Das, was übrig bleibt, sollte ein guter Geschirrspüler schaffen, zumal wir ja wissen, dass es mit alter Technik funktioniert hat! Insgesamt bin ich entsetzt, dass sich technische Entwicklung anscheinend auch rückwärts bewegen kann.Unser 18 Jahre alter Geschirrspüler war in allen Bereichen wie Laufzeit und Trocknung topp und im Wasserverbrauch nicht deutlich schlechter.Sehr ärgerlich, dass wir nun öfter das Geschirr teilweise wieder mit der Hand abwaschen.Für den Preis hatte ich was anderes erwartet...

Comments (English): [ quiet but flimsy and terrible installers ] || ---------------- || Just installed this dishwasher, and not clear how durable it is, but it is very quiet, which is great. Evidently Bosch has issues with quality now. To make things worse, this protective film can only be removed before the dishwasher is installed, since it wraps around all sides of the door, and when pulled it rips apart, but Costco installation asks to remove the film 24 hours after the installation. So, when you try to remove the film from your already installed dishwasher the film breaks and you cannot reach to remove all the small pieces that are now hidden behind the surrounding kitchen cabinets. Another sadness is that Costco, at list in Seattle Eastside area, uses very unprofessional installers, which stood us up 3 times, then came and tried to convince us to pay $250 for installing outlet and replacing the valve, which was evidently unnecessary as we found later. Not sure how different the experience is in other areas.

Also, the flatware holder on the bottom rack doesn't hold enough for our needs (two adults) & the top rack holds long knives & a few other things well enough but is less useful than I imagined. It'd be nice if KitchenAid made something that could sit over the tines to make the racks more efficient/useable.

Sentence (English): We recently had this Maytag dishwasher installed, to replace an old Whirlpool dishwasher that was around 20 years old.
Comments (English): [ Low Frills, but Great Cleaning ] || ---------------- || We recently had this Maytag dishwasher installed, to replace an old Whirlpool dishwasher that was around 20 years old. One thing that I was a little disappointed with in the beginning is the instructions - there is very little there. Most of the information is on a quick-start guide that is the front and back of one page. The rest of the booklet that comes with the dishwasher is mostly warranty info and safety warnings. This model doesn't have a lot of cycle options - there are Auto, Normal, and Quick wash cycles, with a PowerBlast option. There are are also High Temp and Sani Rinse modes, and Heated Dry can be set to Short, Long, or None. Auto is supposed to set the wash options for you, but it is not clear what kind of sensors it is using. It has always set the cycle to Normal with Short Heated Dry when I have pressed it. I have so far run all washes on Normal with no Heated Dry. With the exception of two bowls on two different washes that came out still dirty, everything has come out of the new dishwasher clean, and in most cases it is already dry despite not using the heated dry option. I am very pleased with the cleaning performance and drying on the Maytag. With our old dishwasher we rinsed everything before putting it in and we no longer have to do that. We used to wash anything really dirty or large by hand, and even still some things would come out dirty from the old dishwasher. Plastic items also frequently came out wet from the old dishwasher, but I only have to towel dry items occasionally with the Maytag, and that is without using the heated dry option. The cycles do take much longer than our old dishwasher - I think the Normal cycle usually takes around 2.5 hours. The Maytag is a little quieter than our old dishwasher, but it isn't silent - if you are in the same room you will hear it, and if you are in a nearby room without a door between you may be able to hear it there as well. We got the model in black, and I think it looks nice. With the exception of the controls, a small screen, and the recessed handle, the front is smooth - even the Maytag logo is hidden on the top of the door until you open it. On the inside, the tub is stainless steel and there are two racks. The racks are coated metal and plastic. The utensil basket is solid plastic. You won't find any adjustable items in this one - no stemware holders or tines that fold down. The utensil basket lifts out and goes back in easily. One thing that I like is that it is much easier to put rinse aid into this dishwasher than my old one - someone finally made a design that is easier to pour into. Overall, I think this dishwasher does a great job, and although it doesn't have a lot of features, I think it does the most important things at a reasonable price compared to the other options on the market.

Sentence (English): Review of the LG Dios Objet Collection Dishwasher (Nature Beige), purchased with my own money.
Comments (English): Review of the LG Dios Objet Collection Dishwasher (Nature Beige), purchased with my own money. After much deliberation due to the stress of dishwashing, I finally decided to purchase the LG Dios Objet Collection Dishwasher in Nature Beige. The clean beige design adds a natural, luxurious touch to my kitchen. This unit seats 14 people, allowing me to load a lot of dishes at once. Thanks to the 100% True Steam and Tornado wash blades, it thoroughly removes even grease and sticky residue, which I was very pleased with. I used to find the thought of washing dishes tiresome, but now that it automatically steams and dries with the touch of a button, it's incredibly convenient. I also appreciate the quiet operation, and the satisfaction of seeing my dishes neatly organized is palpable. It took some getting used to at first, but I quickly became accustomed to it.
Comments (Original): ️ LG 디오스 오브제컬렉션 식기세척기 (네이처 베이지) — 내돈내산 후기설거지 스트레스 때문에 오래 고민 끝에 LG 디오스 오브제컬렉션 식기세척기 네이처 베이지를 들였어요.깔끔한 베이지 톤 디자인 덕분에 주방 인테리어가 한층 자연스럽고 고급스러워진 느낌입니다. 이 제품은 14인용으로 한 번에 많은 그릇을 넣을 수 있고,100℃ 트루스팀과 토네이도 세척날개 덕분에 기름때나 끈적임까지 아주 깨끗하게 세척돼 만족스러웠어요. 설거지할 생각만 해도 귀찮았는데, 버튼 한번으로 스팀 세척부터 건조까지 알아서 해주니까 진짜 편하더라고요. 설치 후 조용한 작동음도 마음에 들고, 깔끔하게 정리된 그릇을 볼 때마다 뿌듯합니다.다만 처음엔 적응 시간이 좀 필요했지만, 금방 익숙해졌어요

Sentence (English): Out of the half dozen dishwashers we've had over the years, this dishwasher cleans the best by far.
Comments (English): [ Good, but.  ] || ---------------- || Out of the half dozen dishwashers we've had over the years, this dishwasher cleans the best by far. Very heavy baked in residue on the sides of a crock pot came off totally when placed in the 'power wash' section. Silverware with caked on food came out perfectly clean, as well as dishware. So in sum, we're very happy with it's cleaning ability. Now the 'not so satified' part. This model has top press and touch controls. No tacticle feedback. The paper operating instructions were too brief and directed us to instructions in the app (which we had downloaded). We STILL couldn't figure out how to start the dishwasher. We are senior citizens and had to call our son to come over to figure out how to operate the dishwasher. He's very techy and it still took him 5 minutes and a swear word before he could figure out how to start it. Recently, my wife wanted to change the wash setting from AUTO to NORMAL and spent 10 minutes on the app and still couldn't figure it out. So frustratingly, she had to call me to come upstairs from the Mancave. I've learned to use Google's Gemini as a first resort to answer questions. The procedure to make what should be a simple change in cycle settings was bizarre! Here's what we had to do: 1. Open the door (assumed since it has top controls). 2. Press & hold the reset button for 3 seconds. 3. Close the door. 4. Let the dishwasher drain for 60 seconds. 5. Reopen the door. 6. Press the Start button. 7. Press the desired cycle settings and any additional settings, ie. Sanitize, etc. 8. Close the door. We're praying when we load the dishwasher after dinner tonight, that these settings stuck. If not, we're not going to be happy campers! Come on Bosch. You simply can't design things SO complicated in a kitchen appliance that it takes 2 college graduates and 20 minutes just to operate that appliance. Remember the old acronym, KISS when you design operating controls. I truly regret not getting the front control unit with tactile buttons that give instant feedback. The electronic controls get 1 star.

Sentence (English): This dishwasher has a lot of bells and whistles & you can tell a lot of thought went into the design.
Comments (English): [ Well Thought Out Features ] || ---------------- || This dishwasher has a lot of bells and whistles & you can tell a lot of thought went into the design. The height of the upper rack can quickly and easily be adjusted, and the ability to slide the outside panels of the third rack to accommodate tall items and/or stemware (which has a nice foldaway stem holder) makes it extremely versatile. The adjustable third rack is such a simple yet elegant solution that I was surprised I hadn't seen it before. Since we recently had our first child, my primary interest in this dishwasher was the bottle blasters. Now, they work well, though getting the placement of actual baby bottles right is a little tricky bc of the spacing. I wish they extended up into the rack/bottles - bc baby bottles are so narrow the placement doesn't allow you to use the racks to hold them in place, but we've figured out how to wedge them pretty well. However, for larger adult-sized water bottles, I don't think you'll have any issues. The third rack has sections that are tall enough to accommodate baby bottle lids/nipples, which our old dishwasher didn't, so that's great. The standard cycle gets dishes clean, even those that sat overnight, and I like the option of the 1-hour cycle. I also really appreciate that it pops itself open so the dishes cool & dry off faster. All in all, this has a ton of features and I don't think you can go wrong.

On top of that, it has self cleaning so you'll never need to clean the filter again. Can't recommend this unit enough. One word of caution: the 724 unit is the EXACT SAME minus LED lights inside the dishwasher. I guess that gives a premium look but for 300 extra, wasn't worth it.

Sentence (English): Over the course of time, I've owned Bosch/Thermador appliances including a washer, dryer, microwave, double oven, induction cooktop, refrigerator and finally several dishwashers.
Comments (English): [ You Won't Be Disappointed ] || ---------------- || Over the course of time, I've owned Bosch/Thermador appliances including a washer, dryer, microwave, double oven, induction cooktop, refrigerator and finally several dishwashers. Why several dishwashers? Does that mean they don't last? Not at all. I put one in my first house and in my current house. We recently finished the basement in my current house and added a kitchenette with a Bosch refrigerator and dishwasher. This Bosch is (IMO) "top of the line" as it has Thermador features that I love. For example, there is a light inside the dishwasher. Now, you might ask - why do I need a light inside my dishwasher. I can only tell you that once you have one, you will always crave one. It makes it easy to load without turning on an overhead. This model also has a timer countdown for the wash cycle that projects onto the floor. My contractor asked what was on the floor as he'd never seen anything like it before. We both agreed that it's "so cool" to know how much time is left before the cycle ends (for me this is key as I like to vent the door afterwards). Don't even get me started on the sleek design and look of the model. I mean - everything is hidden inside. If you want it, buy it. If you're on the fence, buy it. You won't be disappointed.

Sentence (English): I really wanted to love this product and rate it highly, but I just can't with the problems we've had with it.
Comments (English): [ I should have bought a Bosch ] || ---------------- || I really wanted to love this product and rate it highly, but I just can't with the problems we've had with it. We bought this dishwasher and a number of other ge profile kitchen appliances when we remodeled our kitchen back in fall of 2021. It's now the beginning of 2026 (so less than 5 years) and we've had to replace the bottom spray arm and it is now on its second leak. The rubber hoses underneath the unit that attach the motor are garbage. The water inlet hose cracked a few years in. If you look this up it is an extremely common problem with these ge dishwashers. Luckily I noticed the puddle of water coming out from underneath shortly after starting the dishwashing cycle or my new kitchen would have flooded (plenty of horror stories on the web about that happening with these. I ordered the part and replaced it myself (paid to have it overnighted and it still took like a week to get here, I had to call GE customer service to get them to send it when it hadn't even shipped multiple days later). To replace it you have to unhook everything from the unit, detach it from your cabinets, pull it out, and flip it over to access the motor. Not an easy job. So I fixed it and now it's leaking from the float seal where the motor attaches, so I have to do basically the same repair all over again (in hindsight, I really wish that I would have replaced this part when I replaced the other one). Luckily, after the last time, I stuck a water sensor under it last time so I was alerted to the leak before it got too bad. To have a dishwasher spring 2 different leaks in less than 5 years is just pathetic engineering, I don't care how good it cleans dishes. After owning dishwashers for over a decade that never had a problem like this, I have to assume that this shoddy craftsmanship is done on purpose to get you to buy a new one sooner. They simply don't make them like they used to. I should've gone with a Bosch instead.

Sentence (English): The cleaning power exceeded expectations.
Comments (English): The cleaning power exceeded expectations. The most satisfying part is its cleaning power. I'm very satisfied because I don't have to re-wash dishes. Storage capacity: 14 people. Perhaps because it's 14-person capacity, it can hold plates, pots, and frying pans all at once. The well-designed upper, middle, and lower baskets make organizing intuitive. I can finish the dishes in one go after a family meal. Noise: Quieter than expected. It's quite quiet during operation. It's not annoying even when running in the evening or at night, and it's convenient to use in the kitchen near the living room. Design: Neat, as expected from an Objet Collection. As a built-in model, it blends seamlessly into any kitchen interior. The design is discreet yet sophisticated. Another advantage is that it doesn't spoil the kitchen atmosphere.

Very disappointed with this purchase.

Sentence (English): This is overall a great dishwasher so far.
Comments (English): [ Great features, great cleaning, questionable leg design ] || ---------------- || This is overall a great dishwasher so far. It is incredibly quiet! I have to put my near close to it to know that it's running. But that doesn't mean it doesn't have cleaning power. This thing cleans like no other dishwasher I've used before! However, it's close enough that we weren't going to bother returning.Installation was a bit of a pain. The included instruction booklet did not have complete instructions, so I had to download the installation manual from online.This unit sits on 3 legs. 2 in the front, and one centered in the back. The 2 in the front adjusts by spinning, and the one in the back is adjusted using a screw accessed directly from the front (making it convenient to level once it's fully in place).My biggest complaint is that unlike the 2 legs in the front, the one in the back has no “foot” to it, so as you slide the unit into place it scratches the floor and, if you have a laminate floor, will completely tear the floor! I now have multiple tears under the unit (tolerable), but also some small tears in front of the unit that are visible. Very frustrating and very very poor design for such an otherwise robust unit.This is my first unit with a 3rd rack. I appreciate that the top rack is not the completely flat type, and has space for cups and glasses. I was worried that overall capacity would be less, but so far I've had no issue fitting my usual loads.The app and WiFi connectivity are nice features, but not incredibly helpful. You can get a notification when the load is finished, which some may find helpful. But there's really nothing you can do in the app that you can't do with the buttons on the unit itself.Only time will tell about the longevity of the unit. So far I'm impressed with the quality and performance. I hope that it will last for many good years.

Sentence (English): It's been close to a month since the dishwasher install was finally completed.
Comments (English): [ Almost a Month Since Install - Still Working ] || ---------------- || It's been close to a month since the dishwasher install was finally completed. The dishwasher is working fine, as you would expect at this point. The appearance fits into the overall kitchen look and feel. The dishwasher is very quiet - much quieter than the previous unit we had.Performance of the dishwasher is meeting our needs - the content are coming out clean, and for the most part, coming out dry with the use of the crystal dry setting. Also using the jet dry rinse agent which is probably helping with the drying action.The third rack setup works pretty well, but definitely is a change coming from a two rack setup in the previous dishwasher.Build quality seems fine. The rack feel a little more flimsy than the previous 20+ year old dishwasher, but they should hold up.Recommendations if you are considering this model:- Purchase a "clean/dirty" magnetic sign. The white light on the front of the dishwasher indicates there is a wash cycle in progress, and you can setup your Alexa and/or google home devices to announce completion of the cycle, but it's easy to miss and it's not obvious at the dishwasher that the dishes are clean.- If at all possible, install this unit yourself, or find a trusted friend/neighbor/family member who can do so. It's not complicated if the plumbing and electrical connections are in place. Make sure the water connection and drain connections are not pinched off as that will result in the machine throwing an error code. You or a trusted installer will be in a better position to ensure it's done right and working right compared to an install team with a tight schedule that needs to complete the job as soon as possible and move on the next install.- Make sure the floor under the dishwasher is not blocked by wires or a junction box from below. Our previous dishwasher was hardwired via a connection from a junction box on the floor. The design of the 800 series requires a clear floor surface. This prevented our dishwasher install for over a week even though all the preparation requirements on the BB site were met.- Consider using the side-mount method for securing the dishwasher vs. attaching to the underside of the countertop. The installers used the countertop and the screws were falling out the next day. I was able to redo the mounting to the sides and it is much more secure.- Make sure to follow the installation guide and/or make sure the installers do so. Be prepared to correct installation errors if you do not do the install yourself, or have trusted installers do the install.- Setup reminders to clean the filter on a regular basis, and also run a cleaning cycle with a dishwasher cleaning tablet on a regular basis.Performance wise, things are fine at this point, but what will really matter is how it's performing in a couple of years. At this point, I expect excellent performance for 10+ years - we'll see how this measures up.

Sentence (English): This dishwasher features a three-shelf design: a top rack for spoons and utensils, a middle rack for glasses, and a bottom rack for plates.
Comments (English): [ Dishwasher Review ] || ---------------- || This dishwasher features a three-shelf design: a top rack for spoons and utensils, a middle rack for glasses, and a bottom rack for plates. While the concept is well thought out and helps with organization, the added top shelf significantly reduces headroom for glasses, making it difficult to fit taller items in the middle rack.The shelves and rollers are made primarily of plastic and feel poorly constructed. Over time, nearly all of the rollers have broken, which makes pulling the racks in and out very difficult and frustrating. Durability is a major concern with this unit.In terms of cleaning performance, it is average and comparable to other dishwasher brands I have owned in the past—nothing exceptional, but it gets the job done. On the positive side, the dishwasher operates very quietly, which is one of its best features.The price was slightly higher than other brands in the same category, which makes the durability and performance shortcomings more disappointing.Overall, the design idea is good, but the lack of durability and reduced rack usability take away from the experience.

Sentence (English): Really like my Bosch dishwasher as I have the last three I bought.
Comments (English): [ Really Like Bosch ] || ---------------- || Really like my Bosch dishwasher as I have the last three I bought. This one cleans very well even on the speed 60 setting. Wouldn't buy any other brand. One thing I do miss on this model is my previous model (which was only three years old and functioning like new and gave it to my daughter when hers broke) is the air dry funtion. My dishes and machine do not dry overnight with door closed. Lots of moisture in there. My solutions to the problem: I do like to use the speed 60 function then when finished I wait a couple hours to cool then keep door partially open and everything actually dries. Still, I like the best cleaning machine as always, a Bosch and only product I would buy for a dishwasher.

Sentence (English): This is overall a great dishwasher so far.
Comments (English): [ Great features, great cleaning, questionable leg design ] || ---------------- || This is overall a great dishwasher so far. It is incredibly quiet! I have to put my near close to it to know that it's running. But that doesn't mean it doesn't have cleaning power. This thing cleans like no other dishwasher I've used before! The “white glass” is not a true white, it's more of a very light cream color. This is unfortunate because it doesn't match our white appliances as we expected. However, it's close enough that we weren't going to bother returning. Installation was a bit of a pain. The included instruction booklet did not have complete instructions, so I had to download the installation manual from online. This unit sits on 3 legs. 2 in the front, and one centered in the back. The 2 in the front adjusts by spinning, and the one in the back is adjusted using a screw accessed directly from the front (making it convenient to level once it's fully in place). My biggest complaint is that unlike the 2 legs in the front, the one in the back has no “foot” to it, so as you slide the unit into place it scratches the floor and, if you have a laminate floor, will completely tear the floor! I now have multiple tears under the unit (tolerable), but also some small tears in front of the unit that are visible. Very frustrating and very very poor design for such an otherwise robust unit. This is my first unit with a 3rd rack. I appreciate that the top rack is not the completely flat type, and has space for cups and glasses. I was worried that overall capacity would be less, but so far I've had no issue fitting my usual loads. The app and WiFi connectivity are nice features, but not incredibly helpful. You can get a notification when the load is finished, which some may find helpful. But there's really nothing you can do in the app that you can't do with the buttons on the unit itself. Only time will tell about the longevity of the unit. So far I'm impressed with the quality and performance. I hope that it will last for many good years.
